visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide, eye-level perspective of a tranquil blue lake under a clear sky with white clouds, viewed through a large window frame. Large white Chinese characters are centered. A green park area is visible along the shoreline. (2) The scene shifts to the interior of a brightly lit hotel room with white bedding in the foreground; a wide window reveals the same expansive lake view. (3) A sequence of outdoor shots follows, featuring a large white 'BIWAKO' sign on a gravel path and a bronze sculpture of a cyclist on a rock. (4) Several people are seen walking toward a unique, grass-covered pyramid structure with small windows. The lighting is bright natural daylight. (5) A tour of a spacious hotel room is shown, featuring multiple beds, a desk, and a television, all illuminated by soft indoor lighting and natural light from large windows. (6) A hand is seen opening a box of hotel amenities, including cotton swabs and brushes labeled 'HAJIMARI ORGANIC'. Two white and gold hair dryers are displayed on a stand. (7) A Japanese-style room with tatami mats, low chairs, and a table is showcased, positioned directly next to a window with a lake view. (8) In a restaurant setting, a woman with dark hair wearing a white shirt is shown eating a steak and gesturing with a thumbs-up. Close-ups of the food, including a salad and steak being cut, are featured. (9) The video shows a breakfast buffet with various dishes, including a rice cooker with white rice and a pot of miso soup. Hands are seen scooping food into bowls. (10) A four-way split screen displays hotel facilities: a gym with treadmills, an indoor basketball court, a planetarium, and an outdoor tennis court. (11) The final shots include the hotel's lobby with modern furniture and a closing screen with the Rakuten Travel logo and a call to action.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a mid-tempo acoustic pop song featuring a female singer in French. Simultaneously, a clear, friendly Mandarin female voice starts narrating the travel experience. The sound of an acoustic guitar strumming provides a warm harmonic base with a gentle percussion beat. (2) As the narration describes the hotel room amenities, the BGM continues at a consistent volume. A very faint, high-frequency sound of rustling plastic is heard as items are revealed. (3) During the description of the steak, a distinct percussive clinking of metal against ceramic is heard, corresponding to the use of cutlery. The narrator's voice remains energetic and positive. (4) The audio transitions into a description of the breakfast buffet; subtle, broadband ambient sounds of the restaurant environment are audible beneath the dominant narration and BGM. (5) The video concludes with the narrator making a final recommendation as the French pop music gradually fades out. The overall mix is clean with a high signal-to-noise ratio.
